recommendedTextbook.title: New General Mathematics for Junior Secondary Schools 2
recommendedTextbook.author: M.F. Macrae, A.O. Kalejaiye, Z.I. Chima, G.U. Garba

topics.topic: Whole Numbers: Standard Form and Quantitative Scientific Notation
subtopics: Writing large and small numbers in standard form A × 10^n where 1 ≤ A < 10
Converting from standard form to ordinary numbers
Operations with numbers in standard form
objectives: Express astronomical distances and microscopic measurements in standard form
Convert scientific notation numbers back into decimal representations
Multiply and divide numbers in standard index notation

topics.topic: Fractions, Decimals and Commercial Transactions: Household Budgeting
subtopics: Expressing one quantity as a percentage of another
Profit and loss percentage calculations in trading
Simple household and cooperative budgeting in Nigeria
objectives: Calculate percentage profit and loss on market goods bought at wholesale
Prepare a balanced personal monthly budget with income and expenditures

topics.topic: Commercial Arithmetic: Simple Interest and Bank Calculations
subtopics: Principal, rate, time, and simple interest formula: I = (P × R × T) / 100
Total amount payable: A = P + I
Calculating interest on agricultural micro-credit and bank deposits in Naira
objectives: State and derive the simple interest formula
Calculate simple interest given Principal, Rate, and Time in years/months
Solve practical banking word problems involving savings loans

topics.topic: Algebraic Expressions: Expansion and Factorization of Simple Binomials
subtopics: Expanding expressions like a(b + c) and (a + b)(c + d)
Factorization by taking out common algebraic factors
Factorization by grouping 4 terms into pairs
objectives: Expand products of algebraic binomial expressions using the FOIL method
Factorize algebraic expressions completely by identifying the highest common factor

topics.topic: Algebraic Fractions: Simplification and Common Denominators
subtopics: Simplifying algebraic fractions by factorizing numerator and denominator
Addition and subtraction of algebraic fractions with monomial denominators
Multiplication and division of algebraic fractions
objectives: Reduce algebraic fractions to lowest terms
Find LCM of algebraic terms and perform addition/subtraction

topics.topic: Linear Inequalities in One Unknown: Graphical Representation
subtopics: Inequality symbols: <, >, ≤, ≥
Solving linear inequalities (rule when multiplying/dividing by negative numbers)
Representing solutions on the number line using open and filled circles
objectives: Solve linear inequalities in one variable
Apply the sign reversal rule when multiplying by negative scalars
Graph solution intervals accurately on number lines

subtopics: Diagnostic evaluation on standard form, interest, expansion, and inequalities
Remedial clinic for struggling students
objectives: Assess mid-term comprehension and deliver targeted interventions

topics.topic: Plane Geometry: Angles at a Point, on a Straight Line, and Intersecting Lines
subtopics: Sum of angles on a straight line equals 180 degrees
Angles at a point sum to 360 degrees
Vertically opposite angles and adjacent angles
objectives: Calculate unknown angles on intersecting lines with geometrical reasons
Apply angle theorems to solve geometric diagram problems

topics.topic: Plane Geometry: Parallel Lines and Transversals
subtopics: Corresponding angles (F-angles)
Alternate angles (Z-angles)
Interior co-interior angles summing to 180 degrees (C-angles)
objectives: Identify corresponding, alternate, and allied angles formed by parallel lines cut by transversals
Solve multi-step geometric angle calculations

topics.topic: Polygons: Properties and Sum of Angles of Triangles & Quadrilaterals
subtopics: Sum of interior angles of a triangle is 180 degrees
Exterior angle theorem of a triangle
Sum of interior angles of an n-sided polygon: (n - 2) × 180 degrees
objectives: Prove that interior angles of a triangle sum to 180 degrees
Calculate interior and exterior angles of regular polygons up to decagons

topics.topic: Pythagoras' Theorem and Practical Real-World Applications
subtopics: Statement of Pythagoras Theorem for right-angled triangles: a^2 + b^2 = c^2
Calculating hypotenuse and remaining sides
Real-life applications: ladders leaning against walls, roof trusses, distance across fields
objectives: State and apply Pythagoras Theorem to find unknown side lengths
Identify common Pythagorean triples (3-4-5, 5-12-13, 8-15-17)
Solve practical Nigerian construction measurement scenarios

topics.topic: Statistics: Data Presentation, Frequency Tables and Bar Charts
subtopics: Collection and organization of statistical data
Tally marks and frequency distribution tables
Drawing and interpreting vertical and horizontal bar charts and pictograms
objectives: Organize ungrouped raw data into frequency tables with tally marks
Construct scaled bar charts representing school attendance or market prices

subtopics: Full termly syllabus revision and terminal examination moderation
objectives: Demonstrate complete mastery of JSS 2 Mathematics Term 1 concepts
